verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Rollbar staff statement that customers store credentials for third-party integrations including JIRA and GitHub. That shows a JIRA integration exists but says nothing about linking errors to tickets or syncing status. PagerDuty incident resolve sync is incident management, not issue tracking, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: documented error-to-ticket linking for Jira/GitHub Issues/Linear, any Linear support, two-way status sync (ticket close resolves the error, regression reopens it), and first-party docs or hands-on corroboration.
